meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
India mein agar aapki skin acne-prone (muhase wali) hai, toh **₹700 ke andar** kai behtareen serums mil jayenge jo active acne, whiteheads, blackheads aur excess oil ko control karne mein madad karte hain.

₹700 ke budget mein sabse best options yeh hain:

### 1. Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum

* **Price:[www.purplle.com](https://www.purplle.com/collections/serum-essence-salicylic-acid-serum-and-essence#:~:text=2%25%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Face%20Serum%20with%20Witch,Serum%20for%20Skin%20Brightening%20%26%20Anti-Dark%20Spots%7C.)** Approx.[www.purplle.com](https://www.purplle.com/collections/acne-serum#:~:text=Minimalist%20Salicylic%20Acid%202%25%20Face%20Serum%20for,off.%204.2%20%285789%29%2015%20ml%2030%20ml.) ₹549 (30ml)
* **Kyun kharidein:** Yeh acne aur oily skin ke liye sabse popular serums mein se ek hai. Isme 2% Salicylic Acid (BHA) hota hai jo pores ke andar jakar excess oil aur dirt ko saaf karta hai. Saath hi isme green tea (EGCG) hai jo redness aur inflammation ko kam karti hai.

### 2. The Derma Co. 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum

* **Price:[www.purplle.com](https://www.purplle.com/collections/serum-essence-salicylic-acid-serum-and-essence#:~:text=%E2%82%B9206%20%E2%82%B9299%2031%25%20off.%204.2%20%284291%29%2015,15%20gm%2015%20gm%20x%202%20%7C)** Approx.[www.purplle.com](https://www.purplle.com/collections/serum-essence-salicylic-acid-serum-and-essence#:~:text=Shop%20All%20Products%20*%204%20offers.%20Minimalist,-%2010%20ml.%20%E2%82%B9237%20%E2%82%B9249%205%25%20off.) ₹349 - ₹499 (30ml) (Offers mein aur sasta mil jata hai)[www.twasa.com](https://www.twasa.com/collections/salicylic-acid-face-serum-for-acne#:~:text=Regular%20price%20Rs.%20349.00.%20Sale%20price%20Rs.,brings%20you%20the%20perfect%20solution%20with%20our)
* **Kyun kharidein:** Isme Salicylic Acid ke sath Witch Hazel aur Willow Bark extract hota hai, jo active pimples ko jaldi sukhane aur open pores ko tighten karne mein bohot asardar maana jata hai.

### 3. Plum 10% Niacinamide Face Serum (with Rice Water)

* **Price:[beminimalist.co](https://beminimalist.co/products/salicylic-acid-2#:~:text=60ml%20-%20%E2%82%B9%20855%2C%2010ml%20-%20%E2%82%B9,Details.%20Check.%20Delivery%20between.%20Cash%20on%20delivery.)** Approx.[www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/i-tried-these-face-serums-under-rs-1-000-and-they-outperformed-products-twice-the-price-101782884658301.html#:~:text=Table_title%3A%20Our%20Picks%20Table_content%3A%20%7C%20Product%20%7C,EMI%20Tenure%20Check%20Eligibility%20%7C%20%7C%20%7C) ₹645 (50ml) / ₹399 (smaller size)
* **Kyun kharidein:** Agar aapke chehre par active acne kam hain lekin **acne ke purane daag (marks)** aur oil control ki zyada problem hai, toh Niacinamide sabse best option hai. Yeh skin barrier ko repair karta hai aur skin ko clear banata hai.

### 4. Dot & Key Cica & 2% Salicylic Zit Clearing Face Serum

* **Price:[www.purplle.com](https://www.purplle.com/collections/serum-essence-salicylic-acid-serum-and-essence#:~:text=%E2%82%B9206%20%E2%82%B9299%2031%25%20off.%204.2%20%284291%29%2015,15%20gm%2015%20gm%20x%202%20%7C)** Approx.[www.purplle.com](https://www.purplle.com/collections/serum-essence-salicylic-acid-serum-and-essence#:~:text=%E2%82%B9206%20%E2%82%B9299%2031%25%20off.%204.2%20%284291%29%2015,15%20gm%2015%20gm%20x%202%20%7C) ₹399 - ₹450 (20ml)
* **Kyun kharidein:** Yeh specially sensitive aur acne-prone skin ke liye design kiya gaya hai. Isme Salicylic Acid ke sath **Cica (Centella Asiatica)** hota hai jo acne ki vajah se hone wali jalan aur irritation ko turant shant (calm) karta hai.

---

### 💡 Kuch zaroori baatein (Tips):

* **Ingredient Choose Karein:** Agar chehre par **naye/active pimples** hain, toh **Salicylic Acid Serum** lein. Agar sirf **daag aur marks** hain, toh **Niacinamide Serum** behtar rahega.
* **Patch Test:** Naya serum use karne se pehle haath ya kaan ke peeche patch test zaroor kar lein.
* **Sunscreen:** Acne serums lagane ke baad din mein sunscreen lagana bilkul na bhulein.

Aapki skin par active acne zyada hain ya purane daag? Agar aap thoda aur detail batayenge, toh main aapko aur behtar suggestion de paunga.
